articles.title_en: Bureaucratic norms and dynamic Bayesian persuasion
The resolution of uncertainty in the value and probability domains
Motives for delegating financial decisions
articles.abstract_en: Why do some investors delegate financial decisions to supposed experts? We report an on-line experiment designed to disentangle four possible motives. About 800 investors drawn from the Prolific subject pool choose whether or not to delegate a real-stakes choice among lotteries to a previous investor (a “designee”) after seeing information on the performance of several available designees. We find that a surprisingly large fraction of investors delegate even trivial choice tasks, suggesting a major role for blame shifting motives. A larger fraction of investors delegate our more complex tasks, suggesting that decision costs play a role for some investors. Some investors who delegate choose a low quality designee with high earnings, suggesting a role for chasing past performance. We find no evidence for a fourth possible motive, that delegation makes risk more acceptable.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么一些投资者将财务决策委托给所谓的专家？我们报告了一项旨在理清四可能动机的在线实验。从 Prolific 主题池中抽取的大约 800 名投资者在看到几位可用指定人员的表现信息后，选择是否将彩票中的真实赌注选择委托给先前的投资者（“指定人员”）。我们发现，令人惊讶的是，很大一部分投资者甚至会委托一些微不足道的选择任务，这表明推卸责任的动机发挥着重要作用。更大比例的投资者将更复杂的任务委托给我们，这表明决策成本对某些投资者产生了影响。一些进行委派的投资者选择了低质量但高收入的指定人员，这表明他们的角色是追逐过去的业绩。我们没有发现任何证据表明第四可能的动机，即授权使风险更容易接受。

articles.title_en: Network attrition: Theory and policy implications
Dynamic coordination with switching costs
Algorithmic cooperation: A comparison with human play in the infinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma
articles.title_cn: 算法合作：无限重复囚徒困境与人类博弈的比较
articles.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning algorithms play an increasingly important role in economic situations. These situations are often strategic, and the artificial intelligence may or may not be cooperative. We compare human and algorithmic cooperation rates in the infinitely repeated two-player prisoner’s dilemma and study which strategies they choose to cooperate and punish deviations. Through a sequence of computational Q-learning and human-player experiments, we find that our Q-learning algorithms tend to cooperate less than humans, particularly when cooperation is risky or not incentive-compatible. Algorithms often use different strategies than humans, leading to distinct on- and off-path behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 强化学习算法在经济形势中发挥着越来越重要的作用。这些情况通常是战略性的，人工智能可能会也可能不会合作。我们比较了无限重复的二玩家囚徒困境中人类和算法的合作率，并研究他们选择哪些策略来合作和惩罚偏差。通过一系列计算 Q 学习和人类玩家实验，我们发现我们的 Q 学习算法往往比人类更少合作，特别是当合作有风险或与激励不相容时。算法通常使用与人类不同的策略，从而导致不同的路径内和路径外行为。

articles.title_en: New methods to compensate artists in music streaming platforms
articles.title_cn: 音乐流媒体平台补偿艺术家的新方法
articles.abstract_en: We study the problem of measuring the popularity of artists in music streaming platforms. We uncover the space of popularity indices upon exploring the implications of several axioms capturing principles with normative appeal. As a result, we characterize several families of indices. Our characterizations might help to address the rising concern in the music industry to explore new methods that reward artists (from the revenues platforms raise by charging users) more appropriately. We actually connect our families to the new royalties models, recently launched by Spotify and Deezer.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究衡量音乐流媒体平台中艺术家受欢迎程度的问题。我们通过探索具有规范吸引力的几条公理的含义来揭示流行指数的空间。因此，我们描述了几个指数系列的特征。我们的描述可能有助于解决音乐行业日益关注的问题，即探索更适当地奖励艺术家的新方法（通过向用户收费而获得的收入平台）。实际上，我们将我们的家庭与 Spotify 和 Deezer 最近推出的新版税模式联系起来。

articles.title_en: Ranking teams
articles.abstract_en: A principal wants to rank and reward teams in an organization. Agents perfectly observe the local ranking of their teams, and strictly prefer being on higher-ranking teams. I show there exists an ex-post incentive compatible and efficient team ranking mechanism if (i) there is an agent who belongs to every team (supervisor condition), or (ii) whenever two teams share an agent in common, they share at least two agents in common (connectivity condition). I identify a class of organizations for which these conditions are both necessary and sufficient. In the special case where the principal wants to rank every group of co-workers in the organization, there exists a team ranking mechanism if and only if the organizational network is a star.
articles.abstract_cn: 校长想要对组织中的团队进行排名和奖励。经纪人会严格遵守球队在当地的排名，并且更倾向于加入排名较高的球队。我证明，如果（i）每个团队都有一个代理（主管条件），或者（ii）每当二个团队共享一个共同代理时，他们至少共享二个共同代理（连通性条件），则存在一种事后激励兼容且高效的团队排名机制。我确定了一类组织，这些条件对于它们来说既是必要的也是充分的。在校长想要对组织中的每组同事进行排名的特殊情况下，当且仅当组织网络是明星时，才存在团队排名机制。

articles.title_en: Long-run efficiency with local interactions and heterogeneous types
Optimal mechanisms for selling market segmentation
articles.title_cn: 销售市场细分的优化机制
articles.abstract_en: We study optimal mechanisms for a data broker selling market segmentation to a producer. The producer engages in discriminatory pricing and is privately informed about a payoff-relevant parameter. We first characterize a class of markets from which the segmentations in optimal mechanisms can be constructed. If the profit-maximizing prices of different producer types are ordered and only downward or only upward incentive constraints bind, this analysis shows that in any created market either all consumer types are served or just a single one. We then characterize optimal mechanisms for a valuation structure that captures differing product quality. In particular, the consumers are segmented into markets in which everyone is served. Lastly, we give a sufficient condition under which optimal mechanisms are efficient regardless of the binding constraints.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究数据经纪人向生产者销售市场细分的最佳机制。生产商实行歧视性定价，并私下获悉与收益相关的参数。我们第一描述了一类市场，从中可以构建最优机制的细分。如果不同生产者类型的利润最大化价格是有序的，并且仅向下或仅向上激励约束具有约束力，则该分析表明，在任何已创建的市场中，要么为所有消费者类型提供服务，要么仅为单一一提供服务。然后，我们描述了捕获不同产品质量的估值结构的最佳机制。特别是，消费者被细分为每个人都得到服务的市场。最后，我们给出了一个充分条件，在该条件下，无论约束条件如何，最优机制都是有效的。

articles.title_en: Endowments-swapping-proof object reallocation with transfers
articles.title_cn: 通过转移进行捐赠防交换对象重新分配
articles.abstract_en: We study the object reallocation problem with transfers. We show that if a rule satisfies endowments-swapping-proofness, strategy-proofness, individual rationality, and no subsidy (or non-imposition), then it is equivalent to the top trading cycles rule without transfers (TTC without transfers). Therefore, even when transfers among agents are permitted, no transfer occurs under the class of rules satisfying these four properties, not even in the form of fixed prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究传输的对象重新分配问题。我们证明，如果一条规则满足禀赋交换证明性、策略证明性、个体理性和无补贴（或非强加），那么它相当于无转移的顶级交易周期规则（TTC无转移）。因此，即使允许代理人之间的转让，在满足这些四属性的规则类别下也不会发生转让，即使是以固定价格的形式也是如此。

articles.title_en: Fair allocation in hierarchies
Rewarding success and failure: Moral hazard and adverse selection in strategic experimentation
Memory overload and asymmetric underreaction
Strong Nash implementation and economic applications
Fair and efficient allocation of indivisible items under category constraints
Weak* dominance
The persistence of disadvantages: Theory and experiment
articles.title_cn: 劣势的持续存在：理论与实验
articles.abstract_en: Many economic situations involve contests for resources, such as winning prizes and earning bonuses. The likelihood of success in such contests is often skewed, favouring some competitors while putting others at a disadvantage. I study the strategic interaction between an advantaged and a disadvantaged competitor in a repeated contest where winning can help overcome the initial disadvantage. Theoretically, the competition for advantage increases effort by both competitors, but that the advantaged competitor increases effort more than the disadvantaged competitor. As a result, the disadvantaged competitor is even less likely to win when they have the potential to overcome their disadvantage, and the initial disadvantage is persistent. Evidence from a laboratory experiment supports these theoretical predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多经济情况都涉及资源竞争，例如赢得奖品和赚取奖金。在此类竞赛中成功的可能性往往存在偏差，有利于某些竞争对手，而使其他竞争对手处于不利地位。我研究了在重复的比赛中优势和劣势竞争对手之间的战略互动，获胜可以帮助克服最初的劣势。从理论上讲，争夺优势的竞争会增加两个竞争对手的努力，但占优势的竞争对手比处于劣势的竞争对手增加的努力更多。因此，当处于不利地位的竞争对手有潜力克服自己的劣势时，他们获胜的可能性就更小了，而且最初的劣势是持续存在的。实验室实验的证据支持这些理论预测。

articles.title_en: Repression and autocratic consolidation
Optimal verification of (mis)information in networks
articles.title_cn: 网络中（错误）信息的最佳验证
articles.abstract_en: We study the diffusion of a true and a false message (misinformation) when agents are biased and able to verify messages. As a recipient of a false message who verifies it becomes informed of the truth, a higher prevalence of misinformation can increase the prevalence of the truth. We uncover conditions such that this happens and discuss policy implications. Specifically, a planner aiming to maximize the prevalence of the truth should allow misinformation to circulate if: non-verified messages may be ignored, transmission of information is relatively low, and the planner's budget to induce verification is neither too low nor too high. Homophily increases the spread of misinformation, but also facilitates diffusion of truth, and leads to similar results on the effect of verification.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究当代理有偏见并且能够验证消息时真实和错误消息（错误信息）的传播。当虚假信息的接收者核实该信息并获知真相时，错误信息的流行率越高，真相的流行率就会越高。我们发现发生这种情况的条件并讨论政策影响。具体来说，一个旨在最大限度地传播真相的规划者应该允许错误信息传播，如果：未经验证的消息可以被忽略，信息的传输相对较低，并且规划者诱导验证的预算既不太低也不太高。同质性增加了错误信息的传播，但也促进了真相的传播，并导致验证效果上的类似结果。
